author: Jimmy John Jacob
title: Dance Thunder rolling in April 11 - NewsBreak
text:
By Jimmy John Jacob ,
16 hours ago After a six-year hiatus, Dance Thunder will take the Cam Henderson Center by storm once again. The event, which will take place Saturday, April 11, at 11 a.m., is modeled after a large-scale collegiate dance marathon. These events raise significant funds for pediatric cancer research and support families impacted by diagnosis and treatment. While some programs last more than 40 hours, Marshall’s Dance Thunder will bring that same spirit into a 12-hour event filled with performances, music and community engagement. Read full article
